name: StoreBadges
title: StoreBadges
summary: Black App Store and Google Play download badges for the dot.Bible app, in two sizes, for light and dark sections, with an optional QR for desktop.
whenToUse: Use wherever the reader can install the dot.Bible app: app pages, AppBanner, footers, language pages.
Use the QR + badges combo on desktop, where the reader is not on a phone.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for links to the web reader; use a Button ("Read online").
Do not restyle the badges as Horizon Blue buttons.

variantNotes: States: default (`--black`), hover (`--charcoal-800`; on dark the border brightens to white 70%), focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`).

states.documented: default (`--black`), hover (`--charcoal-800`; on dark the border brightens to white 70%), focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Badges are always black with white text, on light and dark. On dark sections add the white 40% border (automatic in `.mn-panel-dark`, `.on-dark`, `.sec-ink`).
App Store first, Google Play second; group them in `.mn-stores` with `--space-3` gap.
Use the same size for both badges in a pair. Never go below `.mn-store-sm` (44px).
Show the QR only on desktop; hide it on phones.
These open a store outside ISM, but do not add ↗; the badge shape already says it.
Do not use the official Apple or Google artwork files here; this system draws its own black badges.
